name: scattered broken bricks lying on the ground
label: wasteland_ruins/rubble-b
reasons: 화풍: 칸 정보량이 기준보다 훨씬 낮음 (2/4)

surfaces.part: scattered brick pile lying on the ground, seen from above as a flat patch of brick fragments

answer.evidence: The silhouette is a roughly 16px-wide irregular patch spanning rows 1-15. It is filled with brick-colored fragments, grey chips and dark gaps, and is seen from above. The column scans show no front-edge line, no eave shadow and no vertical front face; the runs alternate between brick and dark colors without any structure. This is a flat floor decal made of scattered debris, which matches the flat kind, so it reads as a top-down slab.

styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a small cluster of a few red-brown bricks, roughly one tile or less, on a plain dark backdrop. It is not a 4x3 ground patch like the grass and paving references, which fill the whole area with continuous surface texture, so the kind does not match. The measured facts are fine: 8 visible tones per tile against 3 for grass and 7 for paving, 0% near-flat coverage, and 0% neutral dark edges, so the outlines lean red-brown rather than black. By eye, the bricks have only about 3-4 ramp steps (light top, mid face, dark edge) with little per-brick grain or chipping. The paving reference has more stone-by-stone shading and mortar highlights. The piece does not cover the ground surface it is meant to be, and it would look thinner and more sticker-like next to the references. When in doubt, fail.
